description: Compound v3 (Comet) market stats on Ethereum read on-chain: utilization, supply and borrow APY, total supply and borrow of the base asset, and every collateral asset with its borrow and liquidation collateral factors, liquidation factor and supply cap. Markets: usdc (cUSDCv3) or weth (cWETHv3). Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_bitcoin_mempool_stats when you need Bitcoin mempool congestion from mempool.space: unconfirmed; crypto_coingecko_market_depth when you need CoinGecko per-exchange market depth for one coin: USD cost. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: crypto_compound_market_stats
title: Compound v3 market stats on Ethereum read on-chain
